MASTER MOTION CALENDAR ON FEB-23-2023 IN 206, DEFENDANTS DARRIAN LITTLE AND TOTAL TRAFFIC CONTROL, INC.'S MOTION TO CONTINUE TRIAL AND TRIAL-RELATED DATES WAS HEARD. KENT KLAUDT, ESQ. APPEARING FOR PLAINTIFF BENJAMIN SANDERS VIA COURTCALL. EDWARD GARSON, ESQ. APPEARING FOR DEFENDANTS DARRIAN LITTLE AND TOTAL TRAFFIC CONTROL, INC. IN PERSON. ARGUED AND THE COURT GRANTED THE MOTION. THE TRIAL DATE OF 03/27/23 IS CONTINUED TO 12/04/23, A DATE AS AGREED TO BY COUNSEL, IN DEPT. 206 AT 9:30 AM. ALL DISCOVERY TO TRACK THE NEW TRIAL DATE. THE COURT WILL NOT GRANT A FURTHER CONTINUANCE OF THE TRIAL DATE ABSENT EXTRAORDINARY GOOD CAUSE. THE COURT ASSIGNED A MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE IN THIS CASE. THE COURT'S ADR COORDINATOR TO SCHEDULE THE MSC BETWEEN 11/4/23 TO 11/12/23 AND WILL EMAIL COUNSEL. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: ANNE-CHRISTINE MASSULLO; MATTER NOT REPORTED (206)
